Shows receptor immunostaining with arrow, but does not visibly show any vocabulary manifestation: no Hunner lesion, glomerulations, mucosal bleeding, urothelial ulceration/denudation, or mast cell infiltration named or visible. No vocabulary finding can be assigned, so excluded per rule 6. B_TRPV4: Top-middle TRPV4 IHC of IC/BPS bladder urothelium. Shows receptor staining only; no vocabulary finding of ulceration, mast cell infiltration, Hunner lesion, glomerulations, or hydrodistention bleeding is described or visible. Excluded - no mappable finding. C_TRPA1: Top-right TRPA1 IHC of IC/BPS bladder urothelium. Receptor localization only; no vocabulary-defined histologic or endoscopic manifestation shown or captioned. in_text_mentions: The immunohistochemical staining of the location of the sensory receptors, TRPV1, TRPV4, TRPA1, P2X3, H-1, and sigma-1 receptors, is shown in Figure 1. These sensory receptors are located mainly in the bladder urothelium. The protein levels of the sensory receptors, inflammatory proteins, and pro-apoptotic proteins in the bladder tissue of the IC/BPS patients and controls, measured using Western blotting, are shown in Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S1.
